---
name: Rule / feature proposal
about: Propose a new rule or governance capability
labels: enhancement
---

**Rule proposal** (if applicable):
- Proposed ID: DG00xx (allocated by maintainers if accepted)
- Detection: exact judgement (what fires, what is skipped)
- Determinism: deterministic / heuristic
- Real incident or pain it prevents (required — rules come from battle scars, not taste)
- Fix direction (if any)

**Willingness to contribute**: yes / maybe / no
